ingredients.raw: ½ cup unsalted butter (1 stick), melted
ingredients.name: unsalted butter

ingredients.raw: ½ cup light brown sugar, packed
ingredients.name: light brown sugar

ingredients.raw: 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips (½ cup chopped, ½ cup whole)
ingredients.name: semi-sweet chocolate chips

instructions.text: Chop ½ cup chocolate chips into small pieces; set remaining ½ cup whole chips aside.
Melt butter in microwave for 20-30 seconds until just melted.
Transfer butter to mixing bowl; add sugars and stir with spatula until combined. Mix in egg and vanilla extract.
Add baking soda, baking powder, and salt; mix well. Add flour and mix until combined.
Add chopped and whole chocolate chips; mix immediately.
Grease 11.5" metal cookie cake pan. Drop dough in chunks, then press into smooth, even layer.
Bake at 350°F for 12-14 minutes until slightly brown on top. Cool completely before removing.
To remove: run knife around edges, place flat platter on top, flip pan over.
Beat softened butter 2 minutes until smooth. Add powdered sugar gradually, then vanilla and salt. Add milk and beat 2-3 minutes until creamy.
Pipe frosting border around edges; add sprinkles immediately.
